name: @pipeworx/mcp-markdown

tools.name: markdown_to_text
tools.description: Convert Markdown to readable plain text (keyless, offline): strips headings, emphasis, code fences, and turns links/images into their text/alt. Ideal for de-formatting Markdown.

tools.name: extract_links
tools.description: Extract all Markdown links [text](url) (and bare autolinks) as {text, url} pairs (keyless, offline).

tools.name: extract_headings
tools.description: Extract the ATX heading outline (# … ######) as {level, text} entries (keyless, offline).

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-markdown forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the markdown pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
